basics.name: Ben Gao
basics.label: Software Engineer / Backend Engineer
basics.summary:
Software Engineer / Backend Developer with experience in backend services, data collection and processing, performance optimization, and Cloudflare serverless applications.
I have a solid foundation in computer science and practical software development experience across the full lifecycle from requirements analysis and system design to implementation, testing, and deployment.
My experience includes backend service development, data collection and processing, performance optimization, and building serverless applications on Cloudflare. I can independently deliver modules and projects end-to-end.
I value code quality and engineering practices, and bring strong learning ability, problem-solving skills, and collaboration.

work.name: Personal
highlights: Continuously building personal and open-source projects covering web full-stack development, backend architecture, Cloudflare serverless deployment, and developer infrastructure.
Independently handled requirements, technical decisions, system design, development, and deployment for a portfolio site, blog system, image hosting platform, and reusable TypeScript libraries.
